note: Tavern keeper, front view, arms hanging, nothing held. Head is the dark grey hair, ears and full beard, bottom y~445 at the beard tip; the teal shirt collar, cream apron with its bib, belt, pocket and the lilac cloth ends at both hips are torso. Each arm is segmented the same way: the teal sleeve is the upper arm to the elbow y~578 (the bare skin patch showing at y~555-595 marks the elbow), the short teal cuff band below it is the forearm to the wrist y~622 (left) / y~648 (right), and the bare fist is the hand (left x272-368, y620-702, right x638-730, y646-720). Hip is the apron hem y~818; the teal trouser strip below it is thigh to the boot tops y~843 (above halfway, so the knee); boots are lower leg to the ankles y~880, boot toes are feet. No equipment.
